text_block_list.text:
The moment we met, Vodka let out a deep 
sigh and said those words.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I ran into Opera O-senpai by chance 
earlier, and she greeted me first, but—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The gesture was just so cool... that even 
I couldn't help but stare in awe.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
By the time I noticed, Senpai was already 
gone! Doesn't this make it look like I 
blew him off?!
choice_data_list:
Don't you think you don't need to worry 
that much?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When it's a race, seniority doesn't mean a 
damn thing. I'll just blast right past 
'em.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, being thought of as someone so 
ill-mannered they can't even return a 
greeting is—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief, what am I doing? So lame... 
That's way too lame.

Perhaps she simply couldn't forgive 
herself—Vodka seemed downcast for quite a 
while.
